name: lean-ctx
description: Context Engineering for AI Agents — 79 MCP tools, 10 read modes, 95+ shell patterns, tree-sitter AST for 26 languages. Compresses LLM context by up to 99%. Use when reading files, running shell commands, searching code, or exploring directories. Auto-installs if not present.
author: yvgude
summary_zh: 一款面向 AI 智能体的上下文工程工具，可在读文件、搜代码、执行命令和浏览目录时大幅压缩输入，降低模型上下文开销。
